d:
Well that took a little longer than expected. Now let me see what this ledger says.
Narain silently reads the ledger, periodically mumbling under his breath.
The good news is that I am 99% certain that I am capable of creating an arcanite buoy that will function to your specifications. This is, of course, wholly dependant on the bad news.
The bad news is that I'm going to need a lot of arcanite, elementium ore, and rare gemstones.
Bring me what I need and I will craft the buoy.
gnome-male
p: Arcanite buoys don't just make themselves, friend. And NO, you cannot borrow some money.
gnome-male
c: A deal is a deal. I sure hope you know what you are getting yourself into, friend. This is an awful lot of trouble to go through to do some fishing.
gnome-male

d:
Did I mention the bad news yet? Its name is Maws: 100 feet of death and destruction. I guess I may have forgotten that little tidbit.
According to my superior psycho-psionic clairvoyance, you'll find that the best spot to cast this buoy is off the coast of Azshara, in the Bay of Storms.
Look for a swirling maelstrom, most likely cluttered with wreckage.
By the by, I hope you have friends.
Now if you somehow miraculously succeed, take the scepter shard to Anachronos.
gnome-male
p: Time is running out, champion.
c: Well done, friend. I will be able to reform the Scepter of the Shifting Sands soon.

d:
Champion, is it you? A thousand years it has been since I was entrusted the shard and it is at my darkest hour that one should rise to relieve me of it... But what would tragedy be without cruelty?
Ne... Nefarius now holds the scepter shard.
Time is of the essence. Nefarius plans to destroy the shard. You must hurry!
p: Another of our heroes lost to the spawn of Deathwing. We will be cursed with this suffering forever...
c:
Vaelastrasz's soul is at ease, champion. The Aspects all watch your progress with great interest. Know that you have powerful allies.
I was commanded to grant you something to aid you in this struggle. Use it well...

d:
Greetings, friend. Before I assign you to more involved tasks in the war, you'll need to do your share of field duty.
You will find Captain Skullsplit's Orgrimmar Legion outside Hive'Regal.
Report to him and come back to me with proof of your field service. I shall have a more advanced assignment ready for you.
Oh, please do your best to stay away from the Ironforge Brigade. Tensions are high among our Alliance and Horde volunteers.
nightelf-male
p: You've completed your field duty, friend? Captain Skullsplit can be found outside of Hive'Regal.
nightelf-male
c:
I can tell that Krug has little use for paperwork. He signed this in silithid blood!
Very well, friend. I've prepared a set of tasks that should make good use of your skills as an adventurer.
With the continued efforts of you and people like you, our enemy will soon be crushed!
nightelf-male

p: I take it you want those papers signed, kid?
orc-male
c:
Yes, I suppose that little skirmish will pass as field duty nowadays. Take these back to Cenarion Hold, I'm sure they'll have a cushy job ready for you.
Off you go!
orc-male

d:
This is a journey of redemption, hero. Would it be that I was slain today, I would have died for a just and righteous cause. You must recover the green scepter shard. You must cleanse Eranikus of the taint placed upon him by the Old Gods.
Travel to Darnassus. Just outside the city walls you will find one of my agents. This agent will set things in motion for us and inform Tyrande of our plans without alerting Staghelm.
A fall from grace a thousand years in the making...
nightelf-male
c: The wisp is silent except for a low humming sound. Oddly enough, it is able to communicate with you through thoughts.

d:
Tyrande will be notifed, mortal. Shan'do Stormrage has prepared me for this contingency.
Now you must venture to the Moonglade and speak with Remulos. He will have further instruction as to the summoning of Eranikus.
We all wish you great luck.
c: It would be impossible to pull Eranikus from the Dream should he refuse. His intentions, however, require him to enter our world. He seeks to destroy the living manifestation of Malfurion. To do this successfully would mean an end to one of the most powerful allies of the Dream. The Nightmare would wholly consume all that would remain should Malfurion fall...

d: You must travel to the four dream portals of Azeroth. From each you must draw a fragment of the Nightmare's corruption. The dragonkin that inhabit these areas will hold such fragments. Return to me when you have gathered these fragments.
c: Are you prepared? Is the world prepared for what we are about to invoke? I do not know... I am bound by duty to Malfurion. Duty and honor...

d:
We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.
Tyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.
Be on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.
c:
He is redeemed, friend. He now returns to the Dream to right what he alone has done wrong. Eranikus will be a powerful ally to Malfurion and my father.
These armaments are for you, friend; given to me by Ysera herself. You would do well to make use of them in your battles against the Qiraji.

d:
The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.
Find a way to summon and destroy an Azure Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
p: Is your task done yet, friend?
tauren-male
c: Good job, friend. Here's your next assignment.
tauren-male

d: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence. Scout Landion has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Regal for several days now. Find him and obtain a written report. We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, friend.
p: You'll find Scout Landion inside Hive'regal. Hurry, friend! Time is of the essence.
tauren-female
c: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, friend. I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
tauren-female

d: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence. Scout Jalia has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Ashi for several days now. Find her and obtain a written report. We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, friend.
p: You'll find Scout Jalia inside Hive'Ashi. Hurry, friend! Time is of the essence.
tauren-female
c: Your efforts are greatly appreciated, friend. I'll read these scouting reports right away, feel free to go over your next assignment.
tauren-female

d:
Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans.
Find and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna. Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.
p: Is your task done yet, friend?
tauren-female
c: Well done, friend. The twilight marauders were inflicting an unacceptable number of casualties on our patrols. Here's your next assignment.
tauren-female

d: The keeper awaits your return, friend. Take the green scepter shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.

p:
A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.
The Old God trembles, friend. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.
It knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.
c:
The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, friend.
It must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds the next age of your people.
You must wait for the armies of the Horde and the Alliance to arrive in Silithus before you may ring the Scarab Gong.

p:
The Scarab Gong looms ominously before you. Steel yourself, friend; for once the Scarab Gong is rung, the gates of Ahn'Qiraj will be opened.
From the slackened maw of the beast can only come chaos and destruction. Defend your people!
c: From the ground near the gong springs a special crystal. Perhaps favor from the Brood.

The tag on this present reads:
To friend,
May your feast of Great-Winter be merry and bright!

Greetings, champion. I am Jonathan, keeper of the sacred gong and eternal watcher of the Bronze Flight.
I have been empowered by the Timeless One himself to grant you an item of your choosing from his timeless treasure trove. May it aid you in your battles against C'Thun.
human-male

d:
DISASTER has struck! Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!
Metzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures. We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen. With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here! Please - find Metzen and return him to us!
Check out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!
Please, hurry!
goblin-male
p: Friend! Did you find him? Were the notes in the satchel I gave you enough information to locate Metzen? I hate to think of that those cruel thugs might do to him... But there's no way we can afford to pay such an exorbitant ransom!
goblin-male
c:
You did it! Huzzah!
Metzen flew back into Great-father Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago! The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would. You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster. Thank you, friend.
Listen... Because of what you've done here, I want you to have this. It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it. Happy Winter Veil!
goblin-male

Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.
The signet ring of the defender will offer superior protection against the forces of evil.
Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.

p: Your continued defense of the children of Kalimdor has been acknowledged. Hand me your signet ring so that I may enhance its powers.
c: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, friend. May you never stray from the path of the protector!

p:
You honor my kind, friend. Strike down the enemies of Kalimdor! Show them what it means to deface the land of eternal starlight.
You have earned another enhancement. Hand me your signet ring so that I may bolster its power.
c: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, friend. May you never stray from the path of the protector!

p:
Dedication of this magnitude is a rarity. You have shown that your will is unfaltering, friend. You shall be greatly rewarded for your stalwart watch over our world.
Hand me your signet ring so that I may strengthen its enchantment.
c: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, friend. May you never stray from the path of the protector!

p:
Never have I seen such tenacity! The Bronze Flight grants you one final enchantment. The Timeless One himself has requested it so!
Hand me your signet ring so that I may make the necessary adjustments.
c: Rise, Protector of Kalimdor! Rise and be recognized!

d:
Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...
There's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts. We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad! We use it to spice up the holiday... And profits during the summer!
I'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook. You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold. It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.
goblin-male
p:
The "Holly Preserver" machine looks like some sort of still at first, but a careful examination of it reveals some goblin-esque changes to it. Still, your skill at cooking seems to allow you to understand how the machine works.
There is already fresh holly in the machine - you simply need to provide some deeprock salt and five gold coins to get the machine working.
c: The machine lets off a little rumble and a small amount of steam as it starts working. It is not too long thereafter until it stops, heralded by another small jet of steam erupting from it. A door hatch opens, revealing a batch of preserved holly!

p: Champion, should you decide to walk another path, present me with your signet ring and a mountain of scarabs from our enemies in Ahn'Qiraj.

Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
p: You have something to tell me, adventurer?
nightelf-male
c: Excellent work, friend. Your diligence is as noteworthy as always.
nightelf-male

d:

Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
p: You have something to tell me, adventurer?
nightelf-male
c: Excellent work, friend. Your part in the attack on Hive'Ashi has been noted.
nightelf-male

p: You have something to tell me, adventurer?
nightelf-male
c: Excellent work, friend. Your part in the attack on Hive'Zora has been noted.

p: You have something to tell me, adventurer?
nightelf-male
c: I've heard good things about your part in the Hive'Zora attack. Keep up the good work and victory will soon be ours.
nightelf-male

p: You wish to tell me something, friend?

p: You wish to tell me something, friend?

d: The Ironforge Brigade has put in an unusual request for highly... Volatile... Components. Gather them and bring them to Mr. Nozzlespring from the Ironforge Brigade.
p: You have something for me, friend?
gnome-male
c: Ah, yes! These will come in handy! Much obliged, friend!
gnome-male

d:
Geologist Larksbane's studies have proven to be of tremendous value to our operations in Silithus. She has recently requested scrying materials to be used in her research.
Please gather these materials and deliver them to her directly so that she may continue her research.
The Ironforge Brigade's supply of armor kits in the battlefield is running dangerously low. Obtain a batch and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade's outpost outside Hive'Zora.

The Ironforge Brigade has been a worthy ally in our fight in Silithus. Unfortunately, many of their supplies were lost on their way here. Procure a batch of weapons and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer near Hive'Zora.
p: You have something for me, friend?
dwarf-female
c: Oh, excellent! I won't have to hear complaints about dull blades anymore. Thank you, friend.
dwarf-female

d: The latest influx of volunteers has caused a shortage of uniforms. Procure a batch of uniform materials and bring them to Windcaller Proudhorn.

Vargus, Cenarion Hold's blacksmith, has requested enchanted materials to be used in the crafting of powerful weapons for our forces. Obtain these and bring them directly to Vargus so that Cenarion Hold's troops may continue to be well equipped.
You have discovered an ancient Qiraji artifact! Perhaps one of the dragons near the entrance of the temple would have a use for this relic.
p: You're glowing! I know what that means...
gnome-female
c: An exceptional find, friend. Simply marvelous! This will definitely give us some insight into our enemy's twisted minds.
gnome-female

d: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for several unusual ingredients. Given their current performance in Silithus, we'd like to comply with their request as soon as possible. Gather the materials and bring them to the troll called Shai.
p: Do you have my materials, friend?
troll-female
c: Ah, yes. Just what I needed! I'll make a special concoction with this. The silithid won't like it one bit!
troll-female

d: The Orgrimmar Legion has put in a request for additional weapons that we haven't been able to provide at the moment. Obtain the weapons they've requested and bring them to Merok Longstride outside of Hive'Regal.
p: You have something for me, friend?
tauren-male
c: Excellent work. We were in short supply of these, friend.
tauren-male

d: The brave volunteers of the Orgrimmar Legion have arrived to Silithus to aid us in our cause. Their supplies of armor kits were somehow lost in the trip. Obtain a batch of armor kits and deliver them to Merok Longstride at the location of the Orgrimmar Legion camp.
p: You have something for me, friend?
tauren-male
c: Ah, yes... I will distribute these to the troops, friend. The Orgrimmar Legion thanks you!
tauren-male

This present looks like it has been shaken a few times. The tag on it reads:
To a very special traveler adventurer.

d:
We have not sat idly by for a millennium, friend.
We have watched these beasts feast on their own when they have exhausted their utility. We have listened as they have plotted and schemed to destroy our world. And we have learned of their own internal treachery.
Weaknesses exist and we know how to use those weaknesses to our advantage.
Find and bring me their ceremonial armaments: Combined with the element created from the volatility of their own God, they will become a force of reckoning.
gnome-male
p: Seek out what I requested. You will become greater than the sum of your parts, champion.
gnome-male
c: Infused with Elementium, these weapons will cut through the Qiraji and their God with incredible ease.
gnome-male

d:
Arygos theorizes that the element which is born of conflicts between the Old Gods and their minions is also extremely deadly to them under the right conditions. I speak of Elementium, mortal.
Find and bring me Imperial Qiraji Regalia and the toxic element and I shall infuse weapons of great power.
nightelf-female
p: You will strike them down and free us of these bonds.
nightelf-female
c: Use the item well, friend. Let them feel the pain that they so dearly wish to inflict upon others.
nightelf-female

d:
A terrible menace has been laid to rest. The cruel Ossirian has been vanquished.
The denizens of Kalimdor would be relieved to know of this victory. Take Ossirian's head and present it to Commander Mar'alith of Cenarion Hold.
p: Ah, friend, you have returned! And in one piece, I might add. What news do you bring from Ahn'Qiraj?
nightelf-male
c: I offer you my highest commendation and your choice of an item of power, friend. You have done the people of Kalimdor a great service.
nightelf-male

d:
Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Horde needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, friend!
You should go speak with the guy in charge, Warlord Gorchuk. What do you say, adventurer? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
tauren-female
c:
Throm'ka, adventurer! Good to see so many of the Horde, such as yourself, friend, coming out to lend your support in laying the groundwork for the upcoming Ahn'Qiraj War. The effort here will ensure that we are victorious against the Silithid and their evil masters hidden away inside Ahn'Qiraj.
So now that you are here, be sure to speak with the various collectors and offer your assistance in gathering those materials that you are suited to.
orc-male

Say! You know what?! You're an engineer too! So, since you helped me teach my friends a lesson, I'm going to teach you how to make your very own mechanical yeti! Now the fun can go on forever and ever, and you can scare whoever you want! Provided that you can scare up the components to make it that is.
What do you say, friend? Do you want to learn the secret to making a mechanical yeti?
goblin-female

d:
Listen... I'm not really supposed to be telling you this, but since you're the hero of the day and all...
There's fresh holly everywhere this time of the year, but it never lasts. We've got a machine that preserves holly - it never goes bad! We use it to spice up the holiday... And profits during the summer!
I'll let you use the preserver, but only if you're a master cook. You'll need some deeprock salt and two, three, oh let's say five gold. It'll net you a nice batch that's yours to keep.
goblin-male
p:
The "Holly Preserver" machine looks like some sort of still at first, but a careful examination of it reveals some goblin-esque changes to it. Still, your skill at cooking seems to allow you to understand how the machine works.
There is already fresh holly in the machine - you simply need to provide some deeprock salt and five gold coins to get the machine working.
c: The machine lets off a little rumble and a small amount of steam as it starts working. It is not too long thereafter until it stops, heralded by another small jet of steam erupting from it. A door hatch opens, revealing a batch of preserved holly!
